$comment: One fixed subject for each image domain, so that the previews compare styles and not scenes. No real persons, no brands.
logo: a logo mark for a fictional coffee roaster: one symbol on a plain ground, centred, no letters, no text, no slogan
photography: a corner of a small-town street with a parked car, a shop front and one person who walks past
film: a still frame from a film: two people talk across a kitchen table at night, with a window behind them
painting: a small harbour with fishing boats, a stone quay, a row of houses and one figure on the quay
interior: a living room seen from the doorway at eye height: a sofa, a low table, a rug, a window on one side and one pendant lamp, no people
